text: I find myself in an environment shaped by modern intellect and purpose. The glass room evokes a sense of anticipation; perhaps a meeting or a lecture is about to begin. Its clarity and openness offer both transparency and vulnerability. Moving past, the vibrant wall of R+D strikes me—here, the spirit of inquiry and experimentation is celebrated. I feel invigorated, curious, yet a bit humbled, aware of humanity’s ceaseless drive to understand and innovate. There’s a quiet enthusiasm within me, as if I am bearing witness to the unfolding of knowledge in real time.
